description: Ranks the six islands reachable by ferry from Ishigaki (Taketomi, Iriomote, Kohama, Kuroshima, Hatoma, Hateruma) for the traveller's time, interests, month, children and sea conditions, with the reasons, the catches, crossing time, boats a day and the cheapest adult fare. Example: "I have one day on Ishigaki with two small kids and want a beach. Which island should we visit?"

interests.description: What the traveller wants to do

month.description: Month of the trip (1 to 12); September to April brings north winds that cancel open-sea routes

rough_sea_or_windy.description: True if the forecast is windy or the sea is rough

time_available.description: How long the traveller has for the island

name: which_island
title: Which Yaeyama island to visit
